chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 540: Ji Ning Becomes a True Immortal and Shatters the Battlefield!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning, now a Pure Yang True Immortal, uses a perfect assassination to kill True Immortal Chibing, shattering the Seamless Gate's morale and turning the tide of the Grand Xia's war in an instant.
og_title: Pure Yang True Immortal Ji Ning Assassinates His First Foe!
og_description: The tide of war turns in an instant as Ji Ning breaks through, kills a True Immortal, and sends an entire army into retreat.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Pure Yang Breakthrough Decimates the Seamless Gate!
twitter_description: A single, silent sword strike changes the course of the war. Ji Ning is now a force to be reckoned with!

lore_anchors.definition: An innate spirit treasure acquired by Ji Ning from the Starseizing Manor. It excels at binding enemies with countless snow-white lotus flowers.
A Ki Refiner who has passed the Heavenly Tribulation and undergone a second metamorphosis, fusing their Celestial Immortal power into Pure Yang energy, granting vastly greater power.
A massive war manifestation formed by the Xingtian Formation, requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a foundation, possessing god-tier durability and power.
A Seamless Gate battle formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, taking the form of a long, serpentine dragon-like creature.
The core of a Pure Yang True Immortal's power, located within their body. If it is shattered, the True Immortal dies instantly.
An innate spirit treasure acquired by Ji Ning from the Starseizing Manor. It excels at binding enemies with countless snow-white lotus flowers.
A supreme Daofather of the Three Realms, known for his bold and forthright temperament. He is the patron of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly and a great admirer of Ji Ning.
A True Immortal known for his selfish and arrogant nature; he had previously refused to take Ji Ning as a disciple, a decision he now bitterly regrets.
A Chinese social concept representing one's reputation, status, and dignity in public; a loss of face is a significant social defeat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning kill True Immortal Chibing so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used the binding power of the Nine-Leaf Snow Lily to trap Chibing, then broke free himself. As a Pure Yang True Immortal in the Xingtian manifestation, he was so much stronger that a single vibration-based sword strike was enough to shatter Chibing's Golden Core.
It's a massive war formation manifestation. It combines the power of a hundred thousand celestial immortals to create a god-like body that is many times stronger than a True Immortal.
